name: VPN
description: WyldeLink — peer-to-peer VPN with WireGuard tunnels (wg0 outbound, wg1 inbound), STUN/TURN NAT traversal, mDNS/DDNS discovery, and a peer-keyed push notification queue. Disabled by default per principle #15 (security default-off).

egress.purpose: DDNS update for the home WireGuard endpoint (DuckDNS provider). Only contacted when discovery.ddns.provider=duckdns and a token is configured.
DDNS update for the home WireGuard endpoint (No-IP provider). Only contacted when discovery.ddns.provider=noip.
DDNS update via Cloudflare DNS API. Only contacted when discovery.ddns.provider=cloudflare and zone_id is configured.
DDNS update via FreeDNS / Afraid.org. Only contacted when discovery.ddns.provider=afraid.
RFC 5389 STUN binding requests for NAT classification + public-endpoint discovery. Server set is configurable via link.stun_servers; default is Google's public STUN cluster.
RFC 5766 TURN allocation against the operator-supplied coturn relay. Only contacted when link.relay.host is configured. Transport is UDP, target is per-deployment.
Outbound POST to a peer's webhook URL when push_store delivers a notification. Target is per-peer (set during /api/push/subscribe with kind=webhook); not a fixed destination.
WireGuard handshake + data plane to the configured outbound VPN endpoint (wg0). Only active when vpn.enabled=true and vpn.endpoint is set. Target is operator-configured.
